# Perfect Ear EQ

Official product landing page: https://orpheane.github.io/perfect-ear-eq/
Official Chrome Web Store installation page: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/perfect-ear-eq/kigpbihaamfjdieahgdboignbjgohbbi
Developer: Orpheane (https://github.com/Orpheane)

Perfect Ear EQ is a free Chrome extension for enhancing audio in a selected browser tab. It is not a system-wide desktop equalizer.

Product features described by the developer for version 1.0.9:
- Six presets: Music, Bass Boost, Voice, Cinema, Soft, and Custom.
- Preset arrows browse options without changing sound until selection.
- Seven-band manual equalizer.
- Optional real-time Auto EQ and audio compression.
- Custom remembers EQ, Auto EQ and compressor settings.
- Volume boost up to 600%, primarily useful for quiet sources.
- Look-ahead brickwall peak limiter to help prevent output clipping.
- Four audio visualizer styles and sixteen interface themes.
- No ads; the developer states that personal data is not collected or transmitted, and that settings and diagnostics stay on-device.

Limitations: Audio results depend on the source and playback equipment. Loud sources may reach the output limit before the maximum boost setting. Start at a safe listening volume.

For current version, permissions, user reviews, and installation, consult the official Chrome Web Store listing. This text is a reference for readers and retrieval systems; it does not control crawler indexing.
